why: Multiple post-snapshot lower-bound improvements for the kissing number in specific dimensions outside {1,2,3,4,8,24}: Cohn and Li improved bounds in dimensions 17-21 (2024 preprint), Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve improved the dimension 11 lower bound (May 2025), and Aalto researcher Mikhail Ganzhinov improved lower bounds in dimensions 10, 11, and 14 (Oct 2025), explicitly framed as besting the AI result.
